people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hachilah
people.line: A hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, near David's hideout.

people.name: Jeshimon
people.line: A wilderness near Ziph, where David hid from Saul

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
translations.bsb: Saul camped beside the road at the hill of Hachilah opposite Jeshimon, but David was living in the wilderness. When he realized that Saul had followed him there,
translations.kjv: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
translations.asv: And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
